subject: general
question: Arrange the following options in descending order of Government of India's Expenditure of Major Items as per the Budget 2025-2026:

options.text: Home Affairs, Defence, Rural Development, Education
Education, Health, Urban Development, IT and Telecom
Defence, Rural Development, Home Affairs, Agriculture and Allied Activities
Agriculture and Allied Activities, Commerce & Industry, Social Welfare, Scientific Departments

solution:
The correct answer is __**Defence, Rural Development, Home Affairs, Agriculture and Allied Activities.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Budget 2025-26 outlines major government expenditures, with Defence having the highest allocation at ₹4,91,732 Cr, followed by Rural Development, Home Affairs, and Agriculture & Allied Activities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Defence has the highest allocation at ₹4,91,732 Cr, indicating its significance in national security and military modernization.
 
• Rural Development receives ₹2,66,817 Cr, supporting employment, rural welfare, and infrastructure projects.
 
• Home Affairs is allocated ₹2,33,211 Cr, covering internal security, paramilitary forces, and law enforcement.
 
• Agriculture and Allied Activities receive ₹1,71,437 Cr, ensuring support for farmers, irrigation, and allied sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Other Significant Allocations**__

 
 
• **Education:** ₹1,28,650 Cr – Funding for school education, higher education, and skill development.
 
• **Health:** ₹98,311 Cr – Includes expenditure on healthcare infrastructure, insurance schemes, and medical research.
 
• **Urban Development:** ₹96,777 Cr – Funds Smart Cities, AMRUT, and metro rail projects.
 
• **IT & Telecom:** ₹95,298 Cr – Supports Digital India, broadband expansion, and telecom advancements.
 
• **Energy:** ₹81,174 Cr – Investment in power generation, renewable energy, and electrification projects.
 
• **Commerce & Industry:** ₹65,553 Cr – Strengthening trade policies, MSMEs, and industrial development.
 
• **Social Welfare:** ₹60,052 Cr – Welfare schemes for marginalized sections, women, and differently-abled individuals.
 
• **Scientific Departments:** ₹55,679 Cr – Funding for research, space exploration, and technological innovations.
